The bloc condemned ongoing Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon—including the kidnapping of citizens from Shebaa and actions in Gaza, while criticizing Lebanese authorities for their silence, inaction, and failure to defend national sovereignty ahead of Independence Day. It also denounced what it called blatant US interference in Lebanon's judiciary, security, and financial institutions, and warned against American efforts at the UN Security Council to pass a post-UNIFIL resolution that would effectively cancel Resolution 1701, the November 27, 2024 agreement.

The soldiers had reportedly been captured during fighting in Kidal in April 2026 and held at a militant camp for more than six months. According to the Africa Corps, Russian and Malian forces conducted targeted airstrikes against FLA/JNIM positions before deploying troops to the site, clearing the camp and evacuating the captives. 🇺🇸 🇻🇪 🇬🇾 — According to Reuters, the Trump administration suggested that Guyana cede part of its territory to Venezuela. ➡️ The suggestion was made by Jeremy Lewin, head of policy at the U.S. State Department, who raised the possibility of Venezuela taking partial control of Essequibo during a meeting in Washington in September. ➡️ The remark shocked Guyanese officials, who consider the region's status non-negotiable. Other State Department officials had to reassure them that the U.S. position had not changed. ❗️ Lewin, who left his position in October, confirmed to Reuters that he had held “preliminary” discussions with both countries and said he had acted under Donald Trump's instructions, after Delcy Rodríguez asked the U.S. president to mediate in a letter. ⚡️ Rich in gold, diamonds, and bauxite, Essequibo accounts for approximately two-thirds of Guyana's territory. Its waters are also rich in oil. 💬 Yesterday, Pete Hegseth signed a military pact with Venezuela that provides for the deployment of U.S. troops to the country. Source 🖇 | 🌳 @tupireport
